UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and voice assistant preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Optional display name of the user.

preferredLanguageCode.description: Selected speech recognition and TTS language code.

handsFreeEnabled.description: Whether foreground hands-free listening mode is enabled.

historyEnabled.description: Whether command history logging is enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudCommandRecord.title: CloudCommandRecord
CloudCommandRecord.description: Voice command history entry synced for an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the command owner.

query.description: Recognized or typed user voice command.

language.description: Language code active when the command was processed.

status.description: Execution outcome status of the command.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when command was logged (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user assistant preferences and profile document.

/users/{userId}/commands/{commandId}.description: Per-user synced voice command history subcollection.
